author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m cutting 24 inch by 48 inch tiles using the Montolit Masterpiuma Italica. The foldable arms help support big tiles and the scoring wheel works on any material. I’ve been using the Masterpiuma for years and love it. Many thanks to Montolit for sending the Italica from Italy to Pittsburgh ❤️🇮🇹
title: How to Cut Big Tiles - #shorts #tiletools #tileshower
